purpose: Connect the current AI moment to the real pressures, records, assets, people, and decisions inside water utilities without turning urgency into hype.
staffSummary: Build M01 around one consequential utility situation and one decision: Decide whether a proposed AI use belongs in learning, advisory support, or a human-controlled operational decision path. The learner must leave with a usable AI opportunity and accountability card, not a collection of definitions.
openingSituation: At 2 a.m., a pump is drawing more current and sounding different, but the utility has readings in one system, maintenance history in another, and the experienced operator's judgment in a third place.
learnerDecision: Decide whether a proposed AI use belongs in learning, advisory support, or a human-controlled operational decision path.
analogy: Weather radar can show a storm and support a decision. It does not decide who closes the road. AI can support utility judgment without inheriting utility authority.
learnerOutcomes: Explain Why This, Why Now: AI and the World of Water in plain English and connect it to a real water, wastewater, stormwater, or One Water decision.
Distinguish data, information, intelligence, recommendation, and accountable decision without using one term to hide several different jobs.
Analyze the module situation, identify missing evidence, and name the professional consequence of a weak decision.
Compare how the same question changes across drinking water, wastewater, stormwater, administration, engineering, finance, technology, and public leadership.

Evaluate sources, assumptions, limitations, permissions, and human authority using this boundary: Date every market, workforce, climate, infrastructure, or technology claim. Do not turn urgency, investment figures, or product announcements into proof of utility value.
Create a usable AI opportunity and accountability card with evidence, roles, limits, review steps, and the next accountable action.
Defend the recommendation to Foundation, Practitioner, and Leader audiences while keeping disagreement and uncertainty visible.
curriculumOutcomes: Give Why This, Why Now: AI and the World of Water one clear learning job inside Foundations and Mental Models.
Connect the module to a consequential decision and the AI opportunity and accountability card.
Preserve current content, proposals, enhancements, and contributor records by stable identifier.
Separate verified evidence, Hardeep positions, expert interpretation, instructional scenarios, and unresolved questions.
Create an explicit bridge to the preceding and following modules without duplicating their work.
marketingOutcomes: Describe the practical value as helping a learner make and explain this decision: Decide whether a proposed AI use belongs in learning, advisory support, or a human-controlled operational decision path.
Name the AI opportunity and accountability card as the visible result of the module.
Do not promise savings, compliance, certification, safety, performance, implementation success, or career outcomes without separately approved evidence.
definitionOfDone: The learner explains the core distinctions, completes the required evidence and decision activities, passes distributed checks, saves a complete AI opportunity and accountability card, and names the next accountable action.
